name: Parfait
source:
Parfait is the leader of the fairies and bearer of the Crystallum Lucis. She has weakened since fighting in the Great War, but has been working to restore balance to the kingdom. Parfait runs the Marchen tavern as a safe haven for those afflicted with the Fairytale Curse. She is extremely kind and is close friends with Delora.
[spoiler]Parfait was once close friends with Hildyr, but had to set her past aside and defeat Hildyr to end the Great War.[/spoiler]
